platform.newNone: There's no active conversation yet — just send a message to start one.
platform.compressDone: Compressed: earlier messages were folded into a summary, freeing up context.
platform.compressDoneFallback: Compressed: the summary model didn't respond, so earlier messages were dropped instead — context freed.
platform.compressBusy: I'm in the middle of a turn — let me finish, then /compress.
platform.compressEmptyTooShort: The conversation is still too short — nothing to compress.
platform.compressEmptyNothingNew: Nothing new since the last compression — nothing to compress.
platform.compressFailed: Compression failed (a message may be too large). The conversation is untouched — try again later.
platform.compressNone: No conversation yet — nothing to compress.
platform.modelSwitched: Switched to "{{label}}", effective next turn (the running turn is unaffected). Note this is the global main-chat model: all of Oru's main chats (desktop included) follow.
platform.modelStale: That number is stale — run /model again for the current list.
platform.modelEmpty: No models registered yet — add one in Oru's desktop settings.
platform.help:
Commands I understand:
/new — archive this conversation and start fresh
/compress (or /compact) — compress context now
/model — list models; /model <number> to switch (global, effective next turn)
/mode readonly|work|danger — set approval mode
/status — current status
/stop — interrupt the running turn
/help — this list
platform.capabilityUnavailable: That capability isn't wired up yet — try again later.
platform.commandFailed: That command failed — try again later.

tableGate.editorUnreachable: The editor is not responding, so I cannot tell whether there are unsaved drafts — retry this operation shortly
tableGate.draftUnsaved: {{name}} still has unsaved changes in the editor, so acting now would work off the older version on disk. I stopped. Only the user can do this step — tell the user directly: this table has unsaved changes, please save it (⌘S) and I will carry on.
tableGate.encodingNotUtf8: {{path}} is not UTF-8 (GBK or with a BOM); writing UTF-8 content into it would produce a half-garbled file, so I stopped. Use convert_csv_encoding to raise a conversion proposal for it (converts in place to canonical UTF-8; it rewrites every byte of the file and the original encoding is not recoverable, so the user must confirm). Once the user confirms, re-read the file with read_file and then retry this step. If the user would rather not touch the original, ask whether to save a canonical copy instead.

fileWrite.createPathOccupied: In-lock check rejected: the target path {{path}} is already taken (it may have been created during approval), so the creation was cancelled. Read the existing content first
fileWrite.editTargetNotUnique: In-lock re-check rejected: the text to replace now appears {{count}} times in {{path}}, so the edit was cancelled because the target is ambiguous. Re-read the current content and retry with more context
fileWrite.conflictDeferred: {{path}} has an open conflict card: you and the user edited the same section and the user is deciding. I held this write — once the user decides, the system will hand you the outcome so you can re-decide against the new content. Feel free to do other things or wrap up this turn.
